verdict.rationale: Mistral documents OCR on image inputs "even from low-quality or handwritten sources" and accepts PNG/JPEG photos. Community users report strong results on severely degraded old paper files and handwritten forms. One hands-on tester saw a whole page returned as a single image instead of extracted text, which tempers confidence but does not overturn the other positive reports. Missing for 10: any evidence on skewed or rotated pages, any evidence on stamps or seals, independent benchmarks for photographed documents, and an explanation of the page-as-image failure.

support.subject: As a developer, scanned and photographed documents OCR accurately — skewed pages, stamps, low quality scans included

citations.quote: OCR with image: even from low-quality or handwritten sources.
`image_url`: PNG, JPEG/JPG, AVIF, and other image formats.
Used the predecessor Mistral OCR model to process 55-year-old paper files, most severely degraded, and was very impressed.
